string.text: Makes bush materials fully opaque to AI vision rays (vis 0). Optionally nudges stalkers who are fighting you out of foliage — either to solid cover or advancing toward you. Checks once per second; skips NPCs already moving.
When a stalker fighting you has their torso in bush collision, send them elsewhere. Neutrals/friends ignored. Already-moving NPCs are skipped.
Find better cover: move to nearby solid cover facing you (rejects bush destinations). Advance: move toward you out of the foliage.
